            if (mother_ship.IsNull()) mother_ship = p;
            else {
               if (PLATFORM.SlantRangeTo(p) < PLATFORM.SlantRangeTo(mother_ship)) mother_ship = p;

         writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + " has initialized. Mother ship is " + mother_ship.Name());
      end_on_initialize
